title: Pink Punk Hammer Girl
description: A confident young woman with bright pink hair in a high ponytail stands in a dynamic pose. She wears a pink and black punk outfit with a cropped jacket, shorts, and heavy boots, holding a large purple spiked hammer with a swirling purple energy effect around its head.
prompt: A fierce young woman with bright pink hair in a high ponytail and freckles, wearing a pink cropped jacket with black and neon green details, pink shorts with garter straps, black thigh-high stockings and heavy black boots with purple soles and neon green laces. She holds a large purple spiked warhammer with both hands, the head of the hammer surrounded by swirling purple energy and motion effects. She has a confident smirk and is posed dynamically against a solid gray background, vibrant anime-influenced digital art style.
